title: yba script poop menu
features:
Farming: Auto Farm with item filters, Normal/AFK/Safe Place modes, and adjustable travel; Auto Gamble; Stand, Rib Cage, Shiny, and Rib Shiny farms with stand selection and shiny protection.
Progression: Auto Quest for selected quest objectives, NPC Farm, and Auto Prestige for storyline progression, level quests, and prestige. Vamp Farm mode continues farming after the storyline.
Selling: Auto Sell on max inventory, on pickup, or on a timer; sell selected items, worthless items, or the full inventory.
ESP and Player Info: Player ESP with names, health, distance, range, and color options; Item ESP with names, boxes, Chams, and color options; item spawn and sound alerts; live player stats.
Movement and Travel: Fly, No-Clip, adjustable WalkSpeed and JumpPower, Auto Sprint, and Infinite Dash with power and delay controls. Teleport to map locations, coordinates, or players; save and return to positions; choose Instant or Tween travel.
Player Tools: View Player, Sticker positioning modes, and Stand Pilot with adjustable speed and range.
Utilities: Anti-AFK, FPS Booster, Instant Pickup, AFK Camera, Jesus dialogue shortcut, and Anti Vamp Burn.
Shop and Events: Item and fighting-style purchase buttons, Auto Buy Lucky Arrow, Halloween dialogue, and automatic or manual candy turn-in with a configurable threshold.
SBR: Auto SBR with route, speed, and delay settings, plus horse controls and teleports. The SBR features are intended for the SBR map.
Customization: Save and load configs, change menu themes, set keybinds
